title: Backup and restore
needsDesktop: Backups need the desktop app. This preview cannot read or write files.
unreachable: Could not reach the backup service: {{error}}

backup.title: Back up
backup.description: Saves a copy of this app's own data to a file you choose, on this computer or a drive. Nothing is uploaded.

parts.settings: Meter, trackers, hotkeys, language and privacy
parts.pets: Farming goals, pins and collection progress
parts.logs: Fights in your log library. Can be large.

backup.estimateNote: An estimate of the files as they are now. Capture keeps running while the backup is written; saving to these files only waits a moment while they are copied.
backup.nothingChosen: Choose at least one part to back up.
backup.nothingSaved: Nothing is saved yet for these parts.
backup.limits: One backup holds up to {{files}} and {{total}} in all, {{file}} per file.

over.files: That is {{files}}, more than one backup holds. Leave out saved logs, or export the logs you want to keep from Logs.
over.total_bytes: That is more than the {{total}} one backup holds. Leave out saved logs, or export the logs you want to keep from Logs.
over.file_bytes: {{name}} is larger than the {{file}} one backup holds per file.

backup.cancelled: Backup cancelled. No file was written.
backup.failed: The backup was not written: {{error}} Your saved data is unchanged.

leftOut.body: A backup is not a copy of the whole app folder. It leaves out alert settings, alert history and custom alert sounds, the fight in progress, window positions, replay recordings, bug-report logs and temporary files.

restore.title: Restore
restore.description: Brings back a backup made by this app on the {{channel}} channel. Nothing changes until you confirm, and the app restarts to apply it before capture starts.
restore.cancelled: No file chosen. Nothing was changed.
restore.failed: This file cannot be restored: {{error}} Nothing was changed.
restore.stageFailed: The restore was not started: {{error}} Nothing was changed. Choose the file again to retry.
restore.verifiedTitle: Every file in this backup matched its recorded size and checksum.
restore.replacesTitle: This file exists here now and will be overwritten.
restore.addsTitle: This file is not here now and will be added.
restore.scope: Only the files listed are written. Anything here that is not listed, such as other saved logs, stays as it is. A copy of every file it replaces is kept in the app's recovery folder, and if the restore cannot finish, those copies are put back.
restore.discardTitle: Forget this file without restoring it

confirm.title: Restore this backup and restart?
confirm.body: The app saves collected results and closes, then writes these files before capture starts and opens again. Your current data in every file marked Replaces is overwritten.
confirm.unsaved: Save or discard your settings changes first; the restore would replace them.

restore.staged: Restore ready. The app is closing and opens again with the backup applied.
restore.pending: A restore is waiting and is applied the next time the app starts.
restore.snapshot: A backup is a snapshot from {{date}}. Restoring a file brings it back as it was then: anything saved to it since, such as new pickups, goals or settings, is lost.

recovery.restored: The backup was restored when the app started. A copy of the files it replaced is kept in the app's recovery folder.
recovery.rolled_back: The last restore could not finish, so the files it was replacing were put back as they were. Your data is as it was before the restore.
recovery.failed: The last restore could not be applied, and your files were left as they were.
